profiles.name: Aesthetic & Beauty Clinic
profiles.description: Cosmetic and aesthetic medicine: injectables, skin resurfacing, microneedling, hair restoration and wellness optimisation.
profiles.rationale: Two distinct needs: (1) pre-procedure safety screening before any skin-breaking treatment -- bloodborne virus status, clotting and infection markers; (2) wellness and appearance panels, since skin, hair and nail quality track iron, thyroid, vitamin D, B12 and sex hormone status.

profiles.name: General Practice / Primary Care
profiles.description: Everyday community medicine: routine screening, chronic disease monitoring and first-line investigation.
profiles.rationale: The high-volume core panel that primary care orders daily -- counts, chemistry, glycaemic control, lipids, thyroid and haematinics.

profiles.name: Fertility & Reproductive Medicine
profiles.description: Fertility assessment, ovarian reserve, IVF workup and recurrent miscarriage investigation.
profiles.rationale: Ovarian reserve and gonadotrophin profiling drive treatment choice; thrombophilia and autoimmune screens are standard in recurrent pregnancy loss; infection screening is mandatory before assisted conception.

profiles.name: Sexual Health / GUM Clinic
profiles.description: Genitourinary medicine: STI screening, diagnosis, partner notification and PrEP monitoring.
profiles.rationale: Bloodborne virus and bacterial STI screening form the core, with renal and liver monitoring for antiretroviral therapy.

profiles.name: Antenatal & Maternity
profiles.description: Booking bloods, pregnancy surveillance and neonatal screening.
profiles.rationale: Statutory booking screens (blood group, antibodies, infectious disease, haemoglobinopathy) plus pre-eclampsia and fetomaternal haemorrhage assessment.

profiles.name: Women's Health & Gynaecology
profiles.description: Menstrual disorders, PCOS, menopause, cervical screening and gynaecological oncology.
profiles.rationale: Hormonal profiling for PCOS and menopause, tumour markers for ovarian pathology, and cervical cytology.

profiles.name: Weight Management & Metabolic Health
profiles.description: Obesity services, GLP-1 therapy monitoring, metabolic syndrome and bariatric follow-up.
profiles.rationale: Glycaemic and lipid control drive therapy; bariatric surgery causes predictable micronutrient deficiencies requiring lifelong surveillance.

profiles.name: Sports & Performance Medicine
profiles.description: Athlete health screening, overtraining assessment and performance optimisation.
profiles.rationale: Iron status, muscle damage markers, endocrine axis and hydration/electrolyte balance dominate athlete panels.

profiles.name: Longevity & Preventive Wellness
profiles.description: Executive health checks, preventive screening and healthspan-oriented panels.
profiles.rationale: Broad baseline profiling across cardiometabolic risk, organ function, hormones, nutrition and inflammation.

profiles.name: Endocrinology Clinic
profiles.description: Pituitary, adrenal, thyroid, gonadal and calcium disorders.
profiles.rationale: Dynamic function testing and hormone axis profiling across all endocrine organs.

profiles.name: Rheumatology Clinic
profiles.description: Inflammatory arthritis, connective tissue disease, vasculitis and gout.
profiles.rationale: Autoantibody profiling and inflammatory markers, plus drug monitoring for DMARDs and biologics.

profiles.name: Gastroenterology & Hepatology
profiles.description: IBD, coeliac disease, malabsorption, chronic liver disease and viral hepatitis.
profiles.rationale: Faecal markers and coeliac serology for gut disease; liver panels, autoantibodies and hepatitis serology for hepatology.

profiles.name: Nephrology & Renal Medicine
profiles.description: Chronic kidney disease, glomerulonephritis, dialysis and renal transplant.
profiles.rationale: Filtration and proteinuria assessment, glomerular autoantibodies, bone-mineral disturbance and transplant immunosuppression.

profiles.name: Cardiology Clinic
profiles.description: Chest pain pathways, heart failure, lipid clinics and anticoagulation.
profiles.rationale: Myocardial injury and heart failure markers, cardiovascular risk lipids and anticoagulant control.

profiles.name: Neurology Clinic
profiles.description: Autoimmune encephalitis, neuromuscular disease, demyelination and CSF diagnostics.
profiles.rationale: Neuronal and neuromuscular antibody panels plus CSF analysis define the neurology laboratory workload.

profiles.name: Oncology & Haemato-Oncology
profiles.description: Solid tumour markers, leukaemia/lymphoma diagnosis and myeloma workup.
profiles.rationale: Tumour markers, flow cytometry panels, paraprotein studies and treatment toxicity monitoring.

profiles.name: Travel & Tropical Medicine
profiles.description: Pre-travel risk assessment and post-travel fever or diarrhoea investigation.
profiles.rationale: Imported infection screening dominates: malaria, enteric pathogens, arboviruses and vaccine-preventable disease immunity.

profiles.name: Occupational Health
profiles.description: Pre-employment screening, immunity checks, exposure monitoring and fitness to work.
profiles.rationale: Healthcare worker immunity status, bloodborne virus exposure follow-up and workplace metal or solvent exposure monitoring.

profiles.name: Pre-Operative Assessment
profiles.description: Anaesthetic workup and surgical fitness screening.
profiles.rationale: Baseline counts, clotting, chemistry, group and save, plus sickle screening where indicated.

profiles.name: Transplant Clinic
profiles.description: Solid organ and stem cell transplant assessment and follow-up.
profiles.rationale: Immunosuppressant drug levels plus opportunistic viral load surveillance define post-transplant monitoring.

profiles.name: Paediatrics & Neonatology
profiles.description: Newborn screening, paediatric endocrinology and childhood infection.
profiles.rationale: Blood spot screening, congenital adrenal hyperplasia and neonatal jaundice or sepsis workup.

profiles.name: Allergy & Immunology Clinic
profiles.description: Allergy diagnosis, anaphylaxis workup and primary immunodeficiency.
profiles.rationale: Specific IgE and tryptase for allergy; immunoglobulins, complement and lymphocyte function for immunodeficiency.

profiles.name: Dermatology Clinic
profiles.description: Inflammatory skin disease, skin infection, hair loss and cutaneous autoimmunity.
profiles.rationale: Skin and connective tissue autoantibodies, fungal skin/nail/hair sampling, and the haematinic and thyroid panels behind alopecia.

profiles.name: Critical Care & Emergency Medicine
profiles.description: Acute presentations: sepsis, overdose, trauma and organ failure.
profiles.rationale: Rapid-turnaround chemistry, blood gases, sepsis markers, coagulation and toxicology drive acute decision-making.

profiles.name: Infectious Diseases Clinic
profiles.description: Complex infection, fever of unknown origin, HIV medicine and antimicrobial stewardship.
profiles.rationale: The full microbiology and virology repertoire plus antimicrobial level monitoring.

profiles.name: Drug & Alcohol Services
profiles.description: Substance misuse treatment, monitoring and medico-legal testing.
profiles.rationale: Abstinence monitoring, organ damage assessment and bloodborne virus screening in people who inject drugs.

profiles.name: Haematology Clinic
profiles.description: Anaemia, bleeding and clotting disorders, and haemoglobinopathy care.
profiles.rationale: Counts and morphology, coagulation factor assays, thrombophilia genetics and haemoglobin variant analysis.

profiles.name: Microbiology & Infection Prevention
profiles.description: Hospital infection control, outbreak investigation and screening.
profiles.rationale: Colonisation screening, resistance detection and reference laboratory typing.
